title: Shared Dashboards & Excel Parsing Improvements
description: Introducing a dedicated view for shared dashboards and robust improvements to Excel file parsing and user search.

items.title: Shared Dashboards Tab
items.description: A dedicated "Shared with me" tab on the dashboard home page to easily access invited dashboards.
details: New tab switcher: "My Dashboards" vs "Shared with me"
Lists all dashboards where you have been granted permission
Dashboard cards display "Shared by [Owner Name]" badge
Seamless navigation between owned and shared content

items.title: User Search Improvements
items.description: Enhanced user search functionality for easier collaboration invites.
details: Case-insensitive search for emails and names
Improved search query handling in backend
Real-time search results in invite dialog

items.title: Excel Parsing Engine
items.description: Significant upgrades to the Excel parser to handle complex spreadsheet layouts.
details: Support for multi-row headers and merged cells
Better handling of null/empty values in complex sheets
Fallback mechanism to standard parser if advanced parsing fails

items.title: Dashboard Permissions
items.description: Fixed critical issues with granting and managing dashboard permissions.
details: Resolved "Unique Constraint" error when re-inviting users
Fixed "Type Mismatch" error (String vs Record) in permission queries
Correctly uses `type::thing()` for all permission operations
Atomic delete-then-create logic for updating permissions

items.title: API Routing
items.description: Fixed routing issues for shared dashboard endpoints.
details: Corrected route ordering to prevent wildcard capturing
